scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,hr -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @dekko-isho/api" "npm run dev -w @dekko-isho/web" "npm run dev -w @dekko-isho/hr-admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dekko-isho/shared && npm run build -w @dekko-isho/web && npm run build -w @dekko-isho/hr-admin && npm run build -w @dekko-isho/api
scripts.build:hosting: npm run build -w @dekko-isho/shared && npm run build -w @dekko-isho/web && npm run build -w @dekko-isho/hr-admin
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @dekko-isho/web && npm run lint -w @dekko-isho/hr-admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @dekko-isho/shared && npm run typecheck -w @dekko-isho/api && npm run typecheck -w @dekko-isho/web && npm run typecheck -w @dekko-isho/hr-admin && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: node --test scripts/release-scripts.test.mjs && npm run test -w @dekko-isho/shared && npm run test -w @dekko-isho/web && npm run test -w @dekko-isho/hr-admin && npm run test -w @dekko-isho/api
scripts.test:all: npm run check:env && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:e2e
